title: Red states split on SEC shareholder proposal rule recission
lede: Ohio and Florida state pension investors oppose move to restrict shareholder rights. other Republican financial officers back US regulator.

title: Magyar shows what Hungary’s new policy on Ukraine could look like (Day 198 of the Tisza government)
lede: Péter Magyar plays volleyball with Volodymyr Zelensky, but vows no blank cheque for Kyiv. He is simultaneously hitting Hungary’s oligarchs with a new wealth tax, sidelining Orbán loyalists from sports and culture, and watching Fidesz-friendly pollsters admit his party is now well ahead.
